method: Read 288 source text files and 209 text test/fixture files; parse local TS/Vue import and export paths with alias resolution. Vue route roots, auto component registration, dynamic unresolved expressions and build tree shaking are NOT represented in the static import graph.
caveats: No local pnpm/Playwright/MP production build was executed in this static audit.
A test without direct TS import may still exercise a page through browser routing and runtime.
Unresolved graph paths to 2 contract JSON and 1 image were independently verified to exist in the Git tree.
A reciprocal edge containing an import type is not necessarily a runtime import cycle.
Security of DEV-only routes must be verified in release artifacts, not inferred from guards alone.
